description: Read the character sheets of one of your series: each sheet is a set of AI images of one fictional character, its images (id, view, url), which sheet and which image are chosen, how many sheets the series may still make (3 in total), and the exact price of a new sheet (23 credits for 5 images of a person, 11 for an animal or mascot). Free. Use this before create_character_sheet and tell the human the price. Characters are fictional adults (or animals / mascots), AI-generated: no real or famous people, no children or anyone who looks under 18, no sexual content, no logos or protected characters (refused with CONTENT_POLICY, nothing charged). Everything made here is AI-generated and labelled as such. Requires the "video:read" scope.
name: get_character_sheet
title: Get a character sheet
